data.text: Of David. א  Aleph To You, O Yahweh, I lift up my soul.
ב  Beth O my God, in You I trust, Do not let me be ashamed; Do not let my enemies exult over me.
ג  Gimel Indeed, let none who hope in You be ashamed; Let those who deal treacherously without cause be ashamed.
ד  Daleth Make me know Your ways, O Yahweh; Teach me Your paths. ה  He - ו Vav
Lead me in Your truth and teach me, For You are the God of my salvation; In You I hope all the day.
ז  Zayin Remember, O Yahweh, Your compassion and Your lovingkindnesses, For they have been from of old.
ח  Heth Do not remember the sins of my youth or my transgressions; According to Your lovingkindness remember me, For the sake of Your goodness, O Yahweh.
ט  Teth Good and upright is Yahweh; Therefore He instructs sinners in the way.
י  Yodh May He lead the humble in justice, And may He teach the humble His way.
כ  Kaph All the paths of Yahweh are lovingkindness and truth To those who guard His covenant and His testimonies.
ל  Lamedh For Your name’s sake, O Yahweh, Pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
מ  Mem Who is the man who fears Yahweh? He will instruct him in the way he should choose.
נ  Nun His soul will abide in goodness, And his seed will inherit the land.
ס  Samekh The secret of Yahweh is for those who fear Him, And He will make them know His covenant.
ע  Ayin My eyes are continually toward Yahweh, For He will bring my feet out of the net.
פ  Pe Turn to me and be gracious to me, For I am alone and afflicted.
צ  Tsadhe The troubles of my heart are enlarged; Bring me out of my distresses.
ר  Resh See my affliction and my trouble, And forgive all my sins.
ר  Resh See my enemies, for they are many, And they hate me with violent hatred.
שׁ  Shin Keep my soul and deliver me; Do not let me be ashamed, for I take refuge in You.
ת  Tav Let integrity and uprightness guard me, For I hope in You.
Redeem Israel, O God, Out of all his troubles.
